partnershipPlan: Two patient partners from the cardiac patient group review the plain-language summary; the laboratory director and the emergency nursing lead comment on sampling and turnaround findings before the committee meets.
socialListening: No social media listening; complaints about waiting times in the chest pain unit over the past year are summarised without identifiers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I sat on a trolley for seven hours to be told it was not my heart; nobody could tell me why the second test took so long.
items.implication: Report time saved and explain the pathway to patients at arrival.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My mother always ends up waiting for a third test; I want to know the quicker pathway works for people like her.
items.implication: Report yield and safety for patients aged 75 or over.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the afternoon nobody is free at the one-hour mark; the sample goes at ninety minutes.
items.implication: Treat timing failures as a core outcome and look for fixes that worked.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We can run the assay in under an hour, but not if every chest pain sample arrives at once.
items.implication: Include turnaround data and plan escalation when results exceed one hour.

summary: Four composite voices on waiting, older relatives, sample timing and laboratory load.
